00050 /**
00051  * @brief               Create a combo box widget
00052  *
00053  * HxComboBoxNew creates a new combo box widget.
00054  *
00055  * The height of pRect is the maximum height of the control.  Additional
00056  * strings are accessed by scrolling through the list.  HxDropdownBoxGetBounds
00057  * can be called before creating the combo box in order to pass in an
00058  * appropriately sized rectangle.
00059  *
00060  * Most of the HxDropdownBox APIs may also be used on HxComboBox_t* objects.
00061  *
00062  * @param id           IN:      Unique ID for the widget, defined by app,
00063  *                              or kHxWidgetAutoID to auto-generate the ID
00064  * @param pParent      IN:      Pointer to "parent" widget
00065  * @param pRect        IN:      Pointer to rectangle describing the position
00066  *                                              and size of the control 
00067  * @param hText        IN:      Pointer to the array of strings
00068  * @param count        IN:      Count of strings in hText
00069  * @param attributes   IN:      Currently, only kHxComboBoxDefault is defined
00070  * @param hComboBox    OUT:     Handle to the created combo box, NULL on
00071  *                                              failure
00072  *
00073  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK if successful.  Returns
00074  *                              HX_MEMORY_ERROR if memory allocation fails.
00075  *
00076  **/
00077 HxResult HxComboBoxNew(uint32_t id, HxWidget_t* pParent, 
00078         const HxRectangle_t* pRect, const char* const * hText, int32_t count,
00079         HxComboBoxAttributes_t attributes, HxComboBox_t** hComboBox);
00080 
00081 /**
00082  * @brief               Delete a combo box widget
00083  
00084  * HxComboBoxDelete deletes a combo box created from an earlier call 
00085  * to HxComboBoxNew.
00086  *
00087  * It is not necessary to call this function when quitting the application,
00088  * since the widget's parent calls this function just before the parent is
00089  * deleted.  HxComboBoxDelete only needs to be called when removing a
00090  * combo box at runtime.
00091  *
00092  * @param pComboBox  IN:            Pointer to the combo box to delete
00093  *
00094  * @return HxResult:                Returns HX_OK if successful.
00095  *
00096  **/
00097 HxResult HxComboBoxDelete(HxComboBox_t* pComboBox);
